title: superosc.m~

messages.description: MIDI pitch (60 when nothing is connected), polyphonic via multichannel signals

methods.description: sets the waveform to variable saw
sets the pulse width or saw shape (0 to 1)
sets the maximum detune in cents (0 to 50)
sets the FM input's attenuverter (-1 to 1)
sets the PWM input's attenuverter (-1 to 1)
sets the detune input's attenuverter (-1 to 1)
nonzero expands the module's GUI, zero collapses it
sets the sync mode: 0 always random (default), 1 initially random, 2 fixed golden ratio phases, 3 all locked to 0

body: [superosc.m~] is a MERDA module wrapper around [superosc~], a supersaw-style detuned oscillator. It has a polyphonic MIDI pitch input and CV inputs for FM, PWM (for the variable saw and square) and detune, each with an attenuverter, plus a sync input that takes impulses to reset the phases of all 7 oscillators. It outputs a stereo pair.
